title.en: A Habit I Want to Build

subtitle: 說明一個想養成的好習慣，以及具體的計畫
task: Write about a habit you want to build. What is the habit, why is it important to you, and what is your plan to make it last?
taskZh: 寫一個你想養成的習慣：是什麼習慣？為什麼對你重要？你打算怎麼做，讓它能持續下去？
focus: 說明動機要具體，不只說「對身體好」
用 be going to／plan to 寫出可行的步驟
段落之間有清楚的轉折

en: The habit I most want to build is going to bed before midnight. At the moment, I often stay up until two o'clock watching videos or chatting with friends. As a result, I feel sleepy in morning classes and drink too much coffee.
This habit matters to me because my grades have started to drop. Last month, I fell asleep during a quiz and could not finish it. I realized that staying up late was costing me more than I thought.

To make the change last, I am going to start small. First, I will put my phone on the other side of the room at eleven thirty. Instead of scrolling, I will read a few pages of a novel. I also plan to write down what time I fall asleep every night, so I can see my progress.
Building a habit is not easy, but I believe that small steps can lead to big changes.
zh: 我最想養成的習慣是午夜前上床睡覺。目前，我常常熬夜到兩點，看影片或和朋友聊天。結果，我早上上課時總是很想睡，咖啡也喝得太多。
這個習慣對我很重要，因為我的成績開始退步了。上個月，我在小考時睡著，沒能寫完。我發現熬夜讓我付出的代價比我想像的還大。
為了讓改變持續下去，我打算從小地方開始。首先，我會在十一點半把手機放到房間的另一頭。我會讀幾頁小說，而不是一直滑手機。我也打算每天晚上記下自己幾點睡著，這樣就能看到進步。
養成習慣並不容易，但我相信小小的步驟能帶來大大的改變。

patterns.pattern: The habit I most want to build is …
patterns.example: The habit I most want to build is going to bed before midnight.

patterns.zh: 因此、結果……（說明造成的影響）
patterns.example: As a result, I feel sleepy in morning classes and drink too much coffee.

patterns.zh: 我會……，而不是……（用新行為取代舊習慣）
patterns.example: Instead of scrolling, I will read a few pages of a novel.

patterns.zh: 雖然……，但我相信……（結尾表達決心）
patterns.example: Building a habit is not easy, but I believe that small steps can lead to big changes.
